value.rationale: The Fano incidence graph is a canonical triconnected nonplanar graph and a standard testing ground for graph braid topology. Showing that fourteen naturally embedded hexagon-pair tori form a complete primitive Z-basis is stronger than a rank count and is not automatic for nonplanar graph configurations. The full 336-element character identifies absolutely irreducible eight- and six-dimensional summands and excludes invariant top homology, revealing otherwise invisible symmetry structure.
